Clanlord's Totem
20 Energy
Instant1 min cooldown
Drop the Clanlord's Totem at the target location where it will remain for 15 sec.

The totem emanates an aura for 15 sec, causing allied players within 100 yds to deal AP*0.35 additional damage as Frost damage when they deal direct damage and gain 50% increased honor.

Applies Exhaustion, preventing you from benefiting from similar effects for 1 min.
